sentences.en: Tawny owls are well camouflaged by the colour of their plumage.
sentences.zh: 棕褐色的猫头鹰因为羽毛的颜色而很好地进行了掩饰。

sentences.en: My racial composition is just a camouflage.
sentences.zh: 我的种族构成只是一个掩护。

sentences.en: This species of moth has evolved an ingenious camouflage for blending into its surroundings.
sentences.zh: 这种蛾子已经进化出一种巧妙的伪装来融入周围的环境。

senses.zh: 伪装；隐藏；掩藏 - 伪装物；掩饰手段；保护色 -

mnemonic: 联想记忆：cam（看作came，来）+ou（看作out）+flag（旗帜）+e→扛着旗帜出来→伪装成革命战士
